messages:
Alex W: FYI Acme demo ramp — getting intermittent 503s and throttling. Sales call with them in 30m, can we triage now?
Samir R: On it. Which endpoint and region?
Alex W: /v1/generate in us-east-1, burst to ~1200 rps for 6m then spikes.
Chloe L: Saw the logs — autoscaler didn't spin up in time on the dedicated pool. Queue grew and produced 503s.
Chloe L: log snippet: ```[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] INFO queue_len=512 max_queue=500 accept=false -> 503 overload; [2026-03-21T14:02:56Z] WARN autoscale_delay=46s requested=4 -> provisioned=1```
Jordan (support): Deploy bot shows a small config change around 14:01 that constrained burstpool size. Deploy ID: deploy-20260321-777. :eyes:
deploy-bot: deployment deploy-20260321-777 completed (service: gen-core-dedicated).
Samir R: Can we temporarily raise the burstpool cap and enable faster scale policy? I can push an override.
Maria G: Also Acme asked whether we can guarantee no 5xx during the demo — and if there's pricing for emergency extra capacity. Need a short answer for the exec call.
Alex W: Short answer: we can increase cap and enable faster scale for a short window; that will cost more (burst pool usage billed prorata). Samir, what's the delta?
Samir R: Rough numbers: enabling +2 GPUs in burstpool for 1 hour ~ +$450. If they commit to a week demo reserved addon it's about 25% discount. Those are ballpark — finance can confirm.
Chloe L: Tech mitigation: enable aggressive autoscale policy + prefix KV cache warm-up and fallback route to quantized model v1q for non-critical traffic. That should cut token cost and reduce per-request GPU time.
Jordan (support): Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/poc-overload -> steps 2a/2b to raise cap and rollback.
Alex W: Samir, please apply temporary cap increase now and notify me when done. Maria, I'll give the pricing ballpark on the call and note we can issue a one-off credit if needed.
Samir R: Applying override: `rbctl capacity set burstpool gen-core-dedicated --max-gpus 6 --until 2026-03-21T16:10:00Z`
Samir R: Override applied. Monitoring...
Chloe L: Enabled fallback to v1q for any requests with header `X-Fallback: true`. Will patch routing in 30s.
Jordan (support): We saw error rate drop to ~0.8% 30s after override. :thumbsup:
Alex W: Great — I'm on the call. If they press about SLA guarantees, say we have mitigation patterns (burst cap, model fallback, reserved commitments) and we can follow up with a dedicated uplift quote.
Maria G: Noted. I'll draft a short pricing note and send to Alex for the call.
Samir R: Logs after fix: ```[2026-03-21T14:08:05Z] INFO queue_len=120 autoscale_action=scale_up->3 active_gpus=3 errors=3(0.8%)```
Chloe L: Follow-up actions: 1) revert override after demo window, 2) schedule deeper autoscale tuning, 3) update runbook with this throttle pattern.
Alex W: Thanks team. Quick and messy but good. Sending update to sales thread and Acme. :rocket:
